text: Professional level and duration of studyUndergraduate programs in regular institutions of higher learning, belonging to the category of economics, have a duration of 4 years and confer a Bachelor of Economics degree. Some institutions offer interdisciplinary majors such as "Financial Engineering" and "Financial Technology", focusing on quantitative and technological applications.Discipline positioningBased on microeconomic theory, this paper focuses on the operational mechanisms of financial systems such as currency, credit, banking, securities, and insurance, and studies the pricing logic and resource allocation efficiency of assets (such as stocks, bonds, and derivatives).Development backgroundFrom classical monetary banking to modern financial theories (such as the Markowitz portfolio and the CAPM model), in recent years, it has combined with big data and artificial intelligence, giving rise to emerging directions such as FinTech.
